# Chennai Central Warrenville

> Authentic South Indian Cuisine in Warrenville, Illinois. Dum Biryani, Masala Dosa, Chettinad specialties, and fine South Indian dining.

## Overview
Chennai Central Warrenville is a premier South Indian restaurant located at 28331 Dodge Dr, Warrenville, IL 60555. The culinary program features traditional South Indian specialties including slow-cooked Dum Biryani, paper-thin Masala Dosa, robust Chettinad curries, Chicken 65, steamed Idly with Sambar, and authentic Madras Filter Coffee.

## Key Information
- Address: 28331 Dodge Dr, Warrenville, IL 60555
- Phone: (630) 393-6570
- Cuisine: Authentic South Indian, Chettinad, Tandoori, Indo-Chinese
- Dietary Options: Vegetarian, Non-Vegetarian, Halal
- Services: Lunch, Dinner, Dine-In, Takeout, Online Ordering, Banquet & Catering
- Price Range: $$

## Operating Hours (Warrenville)
- Monday – Thursday: 11:30 AM – 3:00 PM (Lunch) & 5:30 PM – 10:00 PM (Dinner)
- Friday – Saturday: 11:30 AM – 1:00 AM (Lunch, Dinner & Late Night)
- Sunday: 11:30 AM – 9:00 PM (All-Day Dining)
